sections.installation:
=Automatic installation=
1. Automatic installation is the easiest option .
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”
1. In the search field type “Dashboard Plus ” then click “Search Plugins.”
1. Find “Dashboard Plus ” and install it by! Click “Install Now,”
=Manual installation=
1. Download the dashboardplus.zip file to your computer.
1. Unzip the file.
1. Upload the plugin to your ‘wp-content/plugins’ directory, or install automatically via your admin panel.
1. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
